name: Thompson Palm Springs
positioning: Midcentury modern resort hotel in the heart of downtown Palm Springs, with two skyline pools, balconies or patios in every room and an adults-only Upper Stories tower
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable base in downtown Palm Springs
Couples looking for an adults-only stay in the Upper Stories tower

facts.text: Thompson Palm Springs is located in the heart of downtown Palm Springs.
The hotel blends midcentury modern design with Palm Springs' Rat Pack-era heritage.
Rooms are reached along a lush open-air path and are bungalow-inspired, set just above the city for privacy and views.
Every room and suite has a private outdoor space, either a balcony or patio.
Room interiors use desert-inspired elements such as soft stone, light woods and neutral tones with vibrant accents.
The hotel has two skyline pools with views of downtown and the desert landscape.
The pools have cabanas and an adjacent full-service bar serving al fresco bites and craft cocktails.
Lola Rose Grand Mezze serves mezze-style Eastern Mediterranean cooking elevated by California seasonal produce.
The hotel runs curated experiences including happy hours, DJ sets, art tours and morning yoga.
Art throughout the property includes mosaic murals and pieces by local and Indigenous artists.
The resort fee includes drop-off in the house Rivian within a 3-mile radius.
The hotel is pet-friendly, with a maximum of 2 pets.

highlights.text: Upper Stories is a tower reserved for adults 21 and older, whose guests get 24/7 access to a private pantry with complimentary cold beverages, a dedicated pool for adults and in-room Sonos sound systems.
The 1 Bedroom Penthouse looks out on the San Jacinto Mountains and opens onto a massive wraparound terrace.
The 1 Bedroom Bungalow Suite has the largest terrace on the property, with a private cabana and a dining area overlooking Palm Canyon Drive.
Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel is within walking distance of most of the city's highlights.
Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel feels sprawling, with just a few levels of rooms and many open-air communal spaces.

considerations.text: A daily resort fee applies to each room, subject to change.
The entire resort is smoke- and vape-free, including rooms and balconies.
The hotel is a cash-free environment.
